newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan awards Feb jet fuel tender around $261/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan awards Feb jet fuel tender around $261/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp awarded its jet fuel import tender at around $261 per tonne for February 15-28 delivery, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Shen Ao or Keelung, a CPC source said on Tuesday.
The tender, which closed on January 13, attracted a total of 14 offers, he said.
Traders had earlier said that low offers to the tender were around $265 per tonne.
In its last tender CPC bought 32,000 tonnes of jet fuel for second-half January delivery at around $270 per tonne, c-and-f.
